name: GlacierGrid
description:
GlacierGrid connects your energy and facilities data to Claude so you can ask questions about your sites in plain language and get answers grounded in your own systems.

GlacierGrid monitors HVAC, refrigeration, and energy across multi-site operations: restaurants, c-stores, retail, and gyms. This connector gives Claude read-only access to the data behind that monitoring, scoped to your account.

Once connected, you can ask things like:

- Which locations have open refrigeration alerts right now?
- What did we save on energy last month, and where?
- Show me HVAC status and any equipment trending toward failure.
- What sensor readings triggered the alert at store 214?
- Which sites had devices drop offline this week?

 Claude answers using live data from your GlacierGrid account: portfolio overviews,  issues and the notifications sent for them, energy savings, HVAC and refrigeration status, sensor readings, device connectivity, and weather context for a site.

It is built for operators running 50 or more locations who want facility answers without logging into a dashboard or exporting a report.

The connector is read-only. It retrieves and reports your data. It does not change setpoints, close alerts, or modify anything in your systems.

To use it you need an active GlacierGrid account. Access is scoped to the locations your account already covers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GlacierGrid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GlacierGrid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.glaciergrid.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GlacierGrid MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GlacierGrid lists 17 MCP tools, including get_alert_recipients, get_comfort_burden, get_control_events, get_device_connectivity, get_equipment_hvac_status, get_issues, get_notifications_for_issue, get_overview, get_refrigeration_summary, get_savings, get_sensor_readings, and get_thermostat_cycle_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GlacierGrid?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GlacierGrid in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
GlacierGrid requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GlacierGrid is developed by GlacierGrid Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
